name: Newham Bookshop
title: Newham Bookshop: East London's Independent Bookshop Since 1978
description: Independent bookshop on Barking Road, E13, since 1978. Books for all ages, author events and school visits.

sections.title: A bookshop for all.
sections.text: East London's independent bookshop: books for every age, author events, and a team that loves putting the right book in your hands.

items.title: Children's books
items.text: From first picture books to teen fiction, chosen by booksellers who read them.

items.title: Fiction
items.text: New releases, prize-winners and old favourites.

items.title: Non-fiction
items.text: History, politics, cooking, travel and much more.

items.title: Local interest
items.text: Books about Newham, East London and the people who made it.

items.title: Orders
items.text: Can't see it on the shelf? We can order most books in.

items.title: Online
items.text: Shop with us on Bookshop.org and Hive. Your order still supports the shop.

sections.title: Meet the authors.
sections.lede: We host signings, talks and launches in the shop and across London.

sections.title: Bring books and authors to your school.
paragraphs: We work with schools and community groups across East London: author visits, book fairs, bookstalls and supplying school libraries.
points: We arrange visits and supply signed books for pupils.
We bring a stall to your event, fair or conference.
Book lists and orders for school libraries.

sections.title: From a parents' centre to East London's bookshop.
items: Local parents begin an initiative to tackle low educational achievement in Newham.
In March, Newham Bookshop opens as part of the Newham Parents' Centre.
Manager Vivian Archer joins, ten years after the shop opened.
Author events, school visits and bookstalls across London.

sections.text: "The Shakespeare & Company of London's East End."

sections.title: On Barking Road.
sections.extra: Under ten minutes' walk from Upton Park station: turn right along Green Street and we're a few yards along Barking Road. Buses 5, 58, 104, 115, 147, 330 and 376 all stop nearby.
